register.title: Register your company
register.description: Create your account in a few minutes. Our team reviews it within {days, plural, one {# business day} other {# business days}}, and you can already draft your jobs in the meantime.

features.title: Built for how small businesses hire

confidential.title: Your company stays confidential
confidential.description: Your company name isn't shown on the job. It's only shared with candidates in the next steps of the hiring process.

profiles.title: Candidates with complete profiles
profiles.description: Contact details, location, desired role and answers about US work authorization and sponsorship, before you talk to anyone.

languages.title: English, Portuguese and Spanish
languages.description: Reach Brazilian and Latino workers living in the US, with the whole site available in their language.

payTransparency.title: Pay range made simple
payTransparency.description: Structured pay fields make it easy to include the pay range, which states like CA, CO, NY and WA require on job posts.

verified.title: Verified companies only
verified.description: Every company is reviewed by our team, so candidates trust the jobs they see and apply with confidence.

free.title: Free, with no job limit
free.description: Post as many jobs as you need at no cost. Edit, close or republish them anytime from your dashboard.

cost.question: How much does it cost?
cost.answer: Posting jobs is currently free, with no job limit and no credit card required.

approval.question: How long does the company review take?
approval.answer: Our team reviews new companies within {days, plural, one {# business day} other {# business days}}. While you wait, you can already create your jobs as drafts.

ein.question: Do I need an EIN?
ein.answer: No. The EIN is optional, so sole proprietors and small businesses without one can sign up too.

confidential.question: Will candidates see my company name?
confidential.answer: No. The job is shown as posted by a confidential company. Your name is only shared in the next steps of the hiring process.

candidates.question: How do I receive the candidates?
candidates.answer: Candidates apply through the platform with a complete profile, and our team contacts you about the ones who match your job.

manage.question: Can I edit or close a job?
manage.answer: Yes. From your dashboard you can edit, close or republish your jobs at any time.

language.question: In which language should I write the job?
language.answer: In the language you prefer. The site works in English, Portuguese and Spanish, and the job text is shown exactly as you wrote it.

About.metaDescription: Meet Carvalho Consulting Group: consulting, advisory, insurance and recruiting for businesses and families in the United States.
About.title: Carvalho Consulting Group
paragraphs: We are a consulting firm that supports businesses and individuals at every stage of their financial and professional life in the United States.
We bring together business consulting, personal consulting, life insurance and recruiting, so you can handle it all with people who already know your story.

values.title: Integrity and Ethics
values.description: Acting with honesty, transparency, responsibility and respect in every relationship.

values.title: Trust and Commitment
values.description: Building strong relationships, valuing every client and honoring our commitments.

values.title: Excellence and Results
values.description: Pursuing quality in every project, focused on practical solutions and consistent results.

values.title: Growth and Development
values.description: Believing in the potential of people and businesses, encouraging continuous learning and growth.

values.title: Innovation and Strategy
values.description: Developing smart solutions with strategic vision and the ability to adapt.

values.title: Valuing People
values.description: Putting people at the center of every decision, respecting their stories, needs and goals.

values.title: Prosperity and Legacy
values.description: Working so that today's achievements create opportunities and security for future generations.

mission: To turn challenges into opportunities through smart strategies, expert consulting and tailored solutions that help businesses develop, people grow and families build a more secure financial future.
Our commitment is to provide the knowledge, guidance and strategies that create sustainable results, strengthen families and contribute to our clients' prosperity.
vision: To be a reference in business consulting, human development and financial strategy, recognized for excellence, credibility and the ability to transform businesses and lives.
We want to build a legacy of prosperity, helping businesses grow sustainably and helping people and families gain more security, freedom and possibilities for the future.
